name: SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS: DEADWALKER ZOMBIES
description:
Deadwalker Zombies are a disconcerting sight – shambling and groaning with flesh sagging off yellowed bones. A horde of them can unnerve even the most steadfast warriors. Individually, a zombie is a clumsy and slow adversary, but in bulk, they become a significant threat. Bludgeoning aside enemy defences, they lash out with filthy fingernails and crude improvised weapons, heedless of their losses.

This multipart plastic kit builds 20 Deadwalker Zombies, relentless infantry for your Soulblight Gravelords armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. Heedless of pain and knowing nothing of fear, they are capable of overwhelming even mighty enemies who are drowned beneath a mass of grabbing hands.

This kit includes:
– 6x Zombies with 3 leg designs, 5 interchangeable torso designs, and 7 interchangeable head designs
– 6x Zombies with 3 torso designs, 5 interchangeable arm designs, and 6 interchangeable heads
– 2x Zombies with a choice of 2 chest designs
– 2x Zombies with a choice of 2 stomach designs
– 4x Zombies
– 10x Optional grave markers to further decorate your Zombies

This kit comprises 94 plastic components and 20x Citadel 25mm Round Bases. These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
